_: It.23: the FIRST in-game-surfacing custom DIALOGUE. An NPC you can TALK TO — activate him and a top-level player topic 'Tell me about this place.' appears in the menu; pick it and he speaks two response lines (shown as SUBTITLES — no recorded voice, so turn subtitles ON: Settings > Display > General Subtitles + Dialogue Subtitles). The records were always emittable (It.2); what was missing to make them SURFACE: (1) the host Quest must be START GAME ENABLED so it actually runs and its dialogue loads/evaluates, and (2) the DialogBranch must have the TOP-LEVEL flag so the topic is a menu option (not a sub-branch reachable only from another topic). The INFO is conditioned GetIsID == MF_TalkerNpc so ONLY this NPC offers the line. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, walk up to him, press activate — the prompt should be in the list.

npcs.name: Aldric the Forged
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the Sleeping Giant. What brings you here?

quests._: The dialogue HOST quest. startGameEnabled (the default) makes it auto-run so the dialogue below is loaded and evaluated — the single most-missed requirement. No stages/aliases needed for plain conversation.
quests.name: ModForge Conversation

dialogue._: A player top-level topic. `prompt` is the clickable menu line; `responses` are what the NPC says back (subtitles), in order. speakerNpcEditorId adds the GetIsID == MF_TalkerNpc condition so the line is exclusive to him. The build wires Quest->Branch(TopLevel,Player)->Topic(Custom)->INFO(GetIsID).
responses: Welcome, traveler. Everything you see here was forged on Linux.
No Creation Kit, no Windows — just JSON and a stubborn modder.

placements._: Aldric at the It.16b-confirmed Sleeping Giant Inn spawn (0,0,0). coc in, walk up, activate him.
